messages:
samuel: quick alert 1: we observed a cluster of EU clients stuck in repeated reconnects after a probe latency spike. clients end up backing off and not reconnecting for minutes. looks like SSE is hit harder than WS.

anya: when did this start? any deploys?

samuel: started around 10:10 UTC during a small canary in eu-west-2. no config deploy right before, but the regional pool reported CPU pressure. console shows lots of short probe RTTs ~7001000ms then immediate backoff.

kai: can you paste the proxy excerpt?

samuel: sure: ```
[2026-03-23T10:10:59Z] conn=ef12 keepalive sent
[2026-03-23T10:11:00Z] conn=ef12 probe recv rtt=782ms
[2026-03-23T10:11:00Z] conn=ef12 backoff_incremented reason=probe_tail new_backoff=2.2s
[2026-03-23T10:11:01Z] conn=ef12 route=eu-pool-3 sticky=true util=92%
```

Tess: hmm our reconnection policy prefers sticky pool even if it's near capacity. that will make rejoin more likely to fail.

kai: two immediate actions: bump probe RTT threshold for triggering backoff in EU, and temporarily lower stickiness on reconnects during the canary.

anya: visibility problem: probe events are heavily sampled by default. during the canary sampling was at 1%, so the console charts underrepresent the scale. we need a way for SRE to bump probe sampling on-demand.

samuel: agreed. also need to ensure probe-originated reconnects are not counted as normal disconnects for quota/billing. those are ephemeral and inflate disconnect metrics.

Tess: SGTM. We should also add a short-lived metric label e.g., session.disconnect_cause=probe so dashboards can filter.

kai: for the routing change, propose a feature-flagged fallback: on reconnect after probe-triggered backoff, prefer a lower-utilization pool within same region for first two attempts, then fall back to affinity. keep it off by default and roll to 10% traffic.

samuel: can we do the threshold bump + flag + console sampling change in one patch? i'd rather keep the rollout small.

deploy-bot: canary requested by samuel. rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. telemetry id: sse.probe_canary.

anya: alerting tweak: silence the reconnect-rate alert for eu region for 30m during the rollout; also create an adhoc panel showing probe vs user disconnect counts.

Tess: UI request: make probe_sampling adjustable from the Console (read/write for SREs) so we don't have to deploy to increase from 1% to 100% during incidents.

kai: and add a small jitter to backoff increments to avoid synchronized rejoin storms. also increase RTT threshold from 500ms to 800ms for EU for now.

samuel: I'll open PR with: 1) increase RTT threshold in eu config, 2) add jitter to backoff, 3) fallback routing feature flag, 4) console toggle for probe sampling, and 5) metric label for disconnect cause. linking tickets in PR.

ops-bot: flagged: incident created #INC-2026-023-eu-sse-probe. assigned to samuel and kai.

Tess: nice. one more ask: record "probe_reconnects" as a separate timeseries per pool so we can detect bad pools quickly (eu-pool-3 looks suspect).

samuel: good call. will add shepherd/patrol map metric too. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
